# SORA

> SORA is a South African QR table-ordering system for sit-down restaurants. Guests scan a code on their table, order from their own phone with no app or account, and the order goes straight to a live kitchen screen. Guests can call a waiter with one tap, and owners see orders and sales on a dashboard. SORA runs next to the restaurant's existing till.

SORA is currently onboarding a small group of founding restaurants in South Africa on a discounted, paid introductory partnership. Pricing is agreed with each restaurant in writing before any paid service starts. Enquiries are free and carry no commitment.

## What SORA does today

- QR ordering at every table, on the guest's own phone (no app download, no account)
- Live kitchen screen: orders arrive exactly as chosen and move from new to preparing to ready
- Live order tracking on the guest's phone
- "Call a waiter": staff see which table is asking for help
- Pay now or pay after the meal, set per restaurant; staff mark bills as paid
- Menu editing and a sold-out switch that updates every guest's phone
- Owner dashboard with orders and order value by the hour
- Runs on the phones, tablets and screens a restaurant already has

## In development (not available yet)

- Direct POS integration. For now SORA runs next to the restaurant's till, which stays as it is.
- Online card payment. The pay-now flow is built, but no real payment gateway is connected yet.

## Founding Restaurant Programme

- Introductory pricing: a reduced rate for founding restaurants, agreed up front
- Set up together: menu, tables and QR codes prepared with the restaurant before its first service
- A direct line to the people building SORA
